datasets.name: KreditAccDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT   bal_cn_debt, bal_cn_kredit
    FROM (SELECT   bal_cn_debt, bal_cn_kredit, prvch.lammount, prvch.dat,
                   TO_CHAR (prvch.dat, 'MM') month
                   
              FROM (SELECT bal_cn_debt, bal_cn_kredit, lammount, dat
                      FROM (SELECT prvch.id, acc.bal_cn bal_cn_kredit,
                                   prvch.lammount, prvch.dat
                              FROM provarch prvch,
                                   (SELECT id, acc_no,
                                              bal_cn1
                                           
                                           || tipacc bal_cn
                                      FROM ACCOUNT :wh) acc
                             WHERE acc.id = prvch.kredit) provarch_kredit,
                           (SELECT prvch.id, acc.bal_cn bal_cn_debt
                              FROM provarch prvch,
                                   (SELECT id, acc_no,
                                              bal_cn1
                                           
                                           || tipacc bal_cn
                                      FROM ACCOUNT :wh) acc
                             WHERE acc.id = prvch.debt) provarch_debt
                     WHERE provarch_kredit.id = provarch_debt.id) prvch
             WHERE prvch.dat between :minDate and :maxDate
          ORDER BY prvch.dat)
         WHERE  bal_cn_debt = :bal_cn
GROUP BY bal_cn_debt, bal_cn_kredit

datasets.name: ObrDebtDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT   bal_cn_debt, bal_cn_kredit, MONTH, SUM (lammount) obr
    FROM (SELECT   bal_cn_debt, bal_cn_kredit, prvch.lammount, prvch.dat,
                   TO_CHAR (prvch.dat, 'MM') MONTH
              FROM (SELECT bal_cn_debt, bal_cn_kredit, lammount, dat
                      FROM (SELECT prvch.id, acc.bal_cn bal_cn_kredit,
                                   prvch.lammount, prvch.dat
                              FROM provarch prvch,
                                   (SELECT id, acc_no,
                                              bal_cn1
                                           || tipacc bal_cn
                                      FROM ACCOUNT :wh) acc
                             WHERE acc.id = prvch.kredit) provarch_kredit,
                           (SELECT prvch.id, acc.bal_cn bal_cn_debt
                              FROM provarch prvch,
                                   (SELECT id, acc_no,
                                              bal_cn1
                                           || tipacc bal_cn
                                      FROM ACCOUNT :wh) acc
                             WHERE acc.id = prvch.debt) provarch_debt
                     WHERE provarch_kredit.id = provarch_debt.id) prvch
             WHERE prvch.dat BETWEEN :minDate AND :maxDate
          ORDER BY prvch.dat)
   where bal_cn_debt = :bal_cn     
GROUP BY bal_cn_debt, bal_cn_kredit, MONTH

datasets.name: DataSetSumDebt
datasets.sql:
SELECT   bal_debt, MONTH, SUM (lammount) obrdebt
    FROM (SELECT   acc.bal_cn bal_debt, prvch.lammount, prvch.dat,
                   TO_CHAR (prvch.dat, 'MM') MONTH
              FROM (SELECT id, acc_no,    bal_cn1
                                       || tipacc bal_cn
                      FROM ACCOUNT :wh) acc,
                   provarch prvch
             WHERE prvch.debt = acc.id
               AND prvch.dat BETWEEN :minDate AND :maxDate
          ORDER BY prvch.dat)
 where  bal_debt = :bal_cn        
GROUP BY bal_debt, MONTH

datasets.name: DataSetSumKredit
datasets.sql:
SELECT   bal_kredit, MONTH, SUM (lammount) obrkredit
    FROM (SELECT   acc.bal_cn bal_kredit, prvch.kredit, prvch.lammount,
                   prvch.dat, TO_CHAR (prvch.dat, 'MM') MONTH
              FROM (SELECT id, acc_no,    bal_cn1
                                     
                                       || tipacc bal_cn
                      FROM ACCOUNT :wh) acc,
                   provarch prvch
             WHERE prvch.kredit = acc.id
               AND prvch.dat BETWEEN :minDate AND :maxDate
          ORDER BY prvch.dat)
where bal_kredit = :bal_cn           
GROUP BY bal_kredit, MONTH

datasets.name: DataSetSumSaldo
datasets.sql:
SELECT   bal_cn, MONTH, SUM (active) active, SUM (passiv) passive
    FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR (arch.datdate, 'MM') MONTH, arch.datdate,
                 sb_mtoutview.active (
                    arch.pok_ostat,
                    bal.typeid,
                    bal.additionaltypeid
                 ) active,
                 sb_mtoutview.passiv (
                    arch.pok_ostat,
                    bal.typeid,
                    bal.additionaltypeid
                 ) passiv,
                    bal_cn1
                 || tipacc bal_cn
            FROM archost arch,
                 ACCOUNT acc,
                 bal_spr1 bal,
                 (SELECT   acc_id, MONTH, MAX (datdate) datdate
                      FROM (SELECT acc_id, datdate, TO_CHAR (datdate, 'MM') MONTH
                              FROM archost
                             WHERE datdate BETWEEN :minDate AND :maxDate) 
                  GROUP BY acc_id, MONTH) dat
           WHERE arch.datdate = dat.datdate
             AND arch.acc_id = dat.acc_id
             AND arch.acc_id = acc.id
             AND bal.bal_cn = acc.bal_cn1
             :fil
 )
   WHERE bal_cn = :bal_cn
GROUP BY bal_cn, MONTH

datasets.name: DataSetGetBalName
datasets.sql:
SELECT   bal.bal_cn, MAX (balname) balname,
         sb_mtoutview.active (sal.pok_ostat, bal.typeid, bal.additionaltypeid) active,
         sb_mtoutview.passiv (sal.pok_ostat, bal.typeid, bal.additionaltypeid) passiv
    FROM (SELECT bal.balname,    acc.bal_cn1
                              || acc.tipacc bal_cn, typeid,
                 additionaltypeid
            FROM bal_spr1 bal, ACCOUNT acc
           WHERE acc.bal_cn1 = bal.bal_cn :fil) bal,
         (SELECT   datdate, bal_cn, SUM (pok_ostat) pok_ostat
              FROM (SELECT acc.id, arch.datdate, arch.pok_ostat,
                              bal_cn1
                           || tipacc bal_cn
                      FROM archost arch, ACCOUNT acc, bal_spr1 bal
                     WHERE datdate = (SELECT MAX (datdate)
                                        FROM archost
                                       WHERE datdate < :minDat)
                       AND arch.acc_id = acc.id
                       AND bal.bal_cn = acc.bal_cn1 :fil)
          GROUP BY datdate, bal_cn) sal
   WHERE sal.bal_cn(+) = bal.bal_cn
GROUP BY bal.bal_cn, sal.pok_ostat, bal.typeid, bal.additionaltypeid
ORDER BY bal.bal_cn
